title: Parse canonical score lines
statement: Parse lines of the exact form name=score into a name-to-score map. A name is any non-empty string without '='. A score is a canonical base-10 int64: its text must exactly equal the normal decimal rendering of the parsed value, so plus signs, whitespace, leading zeros, and -0 are invalid. For each line validate shape first, then score, then duplicate name. Return the first zero-based failing line with malformed, invalid_score, or duplicate_name.
constraints: use the exact declared error and result types
return an empty map for empty input and preserve every valid score
handle every error and result variant explicitly without catch-all or default branches
do not throw, panic, perform input/output, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

enum ScoreError:
    malformed
    invalid_score
    duplicate_name

enum ScoreResult:
    accepted(scores: map[string, int64])
    rejected(line: int64, error: ScoreError)

function parse_scores(lines: list[string]) returns ScoreResult
